identifier_mapping_reveal.semantics: explicit action; the default evidence view keeps anonymous tokens (normalized_fact is anonymized); plaintext mappings never enter logs, traces or the model context (model_must_never_receive: identifier_mapping)
identifier_mapping_reveal.error_vocabulary: existing controlled codes only (1001/1002/2009); no new codes

tool_runtime.fact_schema_version_evolution: version 1 was the pre-R012 tool fact envelope; all newly executed tool calls emit version 2, while historical Evidence retains and is interpreted by its stored version and is never rewritten or reinterpreted as version 2

builtin_skill_package.carrier: prompt_tools rows with is_builtin=true seeded by migration, database is the only persistent home
builtin_skill_package.content: full legacy AuditRole port minus pt-osc/gh-ost entries, judged from frozen fingerprint group statistics and read-only evidence tools
builtin_skill_package.governance: three tiers: package members cannot be deleted, definitions (name/engine/four-field definition) are system-owned and immutable on replace (definition-hash comparison), parameters are admin-tunable and persisted in the row

parameters.injection: knowledge_text placeholders rendered with current row values
parameters.freeze: parameter values are covered by config_hash; tuning invalidates frozen unsubmitted runs
parameters.builtin_validation: same key set and value types as the row, values free within bounds

builtin_skill_package.engine_scoping: engine column all|mysql|postgresql; per-stage injection filtered by the stage datasource engine

tool_runtime.safe_explain_statement_boundary: final adapter candidate allows only one ordinary plan-able statement head after fixed non-executing EXPLAIN options; ANALYZE/ANALYSE, nested EXPLAIN, EXECUTE, execution prefixes and statement separators are rejected before pool access

reference_pricing.standing_disclaimer: 成本计算仅作为参考，不具备准确性。最终费用以AI提供商或中转服务的实际账单为准。

output_locale.normalization: HTTP language negotiation in preference order; zh and en variants map to supported locale; unsupported or malformed header falls back to zh-CN
output_locale.freeze: sql_grouping and ai_review task input at explicit start; reused for all stages, turns, retries and provider fallback
output_locale.structured_values: preserve keys, enums, finding keys, evidence IDs, anonymous tokens and technical identifiers
output_locale.existing_results: never automatically translate or recompute; explicitly start a new review for a different output language
output_locale.prompt_safety: fixed instructions selected by normalized locale; never interpolate raw request header
output_locale.output_validation: before accepting any model turn, exclude backtick-delimited code and require Han prose for zh-CN or Latin prose without other scripts for en-US; this conservative script guard does not prove linguistic fluency
output_locale.language_correction: one corrective model turn per stage within existing model-turn, call, time and cost budgets; invalid response text and tool requests are discarded; persistent mismatch fails closed with existing REVIEW_SCHEMA_INVALID 2009

metadata_context.sql_context: each group carries representative_anonymized_sql and anonymous object relationships; statement_ordinal identifies the representative and statement_ordinal_ranges authoritatively covers every group occurrence; stable RunMapper shared with tools
metadata_context.discovery: AI chooses read-only metadata tools based on SQL and frozen skills/knowledge, no handwritten per-rule dependency catalog or keyword-specific risk decision
metadata_context.object_baseline: table references require scoped observed existence/definition evidence; SQL index references with an owning table require scoped index_metadata; unsupported object kinds or unbound index/constraint/schema targets are unknown/incomplete, never silently covered
metadata_context.required_context: any requested failed, unavailable, truncated or required-unknown fact keeps the stage partial; existing 2007 and gate semantics apply
metadata_context.pure_lexical: statements without metadata object references need not request database fact tools; mandatory frozen-target identity checks still apply
metadata_context.privacy: no raw SQL, identifiers, comments, literals, mapping or unconstrained metadata text to Provider; only stable tokens and controlled typed facts
metadata_context.facts: schema_metadata requires one SQL-referenced table; no schema-wide discovery; table existence differs from empty columns/indexes; non-base relations are unsupported, never absent; row estimates are observed/unknown/unsupported; arrays preserve controlled element class and dimensions; index key/include roles and expression/prefix presence are explicit, unprojected structures make the profile incomplete
metadata_context.existence_visibility: MySQL absent requires global or schema-level SELECT evidence proving INFORMATION_SCHEMA visibility; PostgreSQL table lookup uses pg_catalog and absent-in-existing-schema requires USAGE, while a missing schema itself is a complete absent observation; present rows never become empty definitions when follow-up metadata reads fail
metadata_context.limits: existing model/tool call, time, byte, depth and global daily cost bounds remain enforced
metadata_context.business_policy: existence/context facts do not hardcode DROP/ALTER/IF EXISTS risk severity; enabled mandatory flow rules apply separately and the trusted runtime validity classifier evaluates batch order and SQL semantics
metadata_context.identifier_equivalence: column and index facts may carry sql_reference_tokens containing exact-name matching real SQL tokens only; quoted case variants, virtual scopes and other identifier kinds never become aliases
metadata_context.target_binding: freeze target configuration into the run input hash and actual server/database identity into encrypted stage context; re-probe and compare before target fact reads; target drift fails closed; Provider sees only controlled engine/version/match status, never original target identity
metadata_context.tool_call_identity: provider tool_call_id is stage-local correlation; storage UUID is derived from run/stage/provider ID/request signature; same ID and identical request is idempotent, conflicting request is a failed auditable call and evidence incomplete
metadata_context.summary_acceptance: accept model summary only after all runtime evidence and finding-reference validation, when final runtime outcome equals model outcome; downgraded complete text is discarded
metadata_context.flow_stage_schema_mappings_removed: RCP-20261031-REMOVE-FLOW-SCHEMA-MAPPINGS: flow stages no longer configure logical-to-physical schema mappings; object scope is always the no-mapping branch (PostgreSQL frozen execution-identity search_path, MySQL datasource default database); flow_snapshot_hash composition excludes the former schema_mapping_ciphertext component

policy_text_privacy.reference_syntax: {{ref:kind:["physical_schema","owning_table_if_needed","object_name"]}}; schema takes one part, table/view two, column/index/constraint three; exact catalog identity only
policy_text_privacy.guarantee_scope: complete bounded catalog snapshot of frozen authorized physical schemas, including objects absent from SQL; inaccessible or unrelated catalogs are not certified
policy_text_privacy.catalog_channel: trusted read_only review credential; local memory only; never Provider tool evidence or bulk model token legend
policy_text_privacy.catalog_incomplete: zero Provider calls on missing visibility proof, missing schema, unsupported catalog reader, timeout, truncation, oversize or malformed catalog
policy_text_privacy.raw_policy_identifiers: reject raw known catalog names in administrator human text/parameters; controlled fixed structure/source IDs/enums are not administrator catalog text; the frozen generic_column_name_allowlist below exempts zero-specificity generic column names from this rejection for the policy-text catalog-word check only

generic_column_name_allowlist.scope: column-kind catalog identifiers only; exempts the policy-text catalog-word collision check only; schema/table/view/index/constraint names, the target database name, statement identifiers and the mapper-token collision check are never exempt
generic_column_name_allowlist.rationale: generic column names exist in virtually every catalog and disclose nothing about which objects exist (zero specificity), while rule semantics legitimately reference them; admin-authored specific names remain fully rejected
generic_column_name_allowlist.extension: frozen; extension requires an approved requirement change proposal and must update this contract, the Go mirror and scripts/contracts/validate_contracts.py in lockstep

policy_text_privacy.reference_resolution: resolve typed references exactly, tokenize only declared objects, reject unresolved/malformed/ambiguous references before send; include raw text in existing config_hash and immutable policy snapshot
policy_text_privacy.enablement: validate placeholder grammar and parameter completeness; exact per-target catalog resolution occurs before send because global/engine policies lack a configured target
policy_text_privacy.retry: revalidate complete current authorized catalog before every Provider attempt/turn; stable Run tokens and frozen policy definitions remain bound; failure never invokes model

generation_params.plan_identity_note: generation params join provider id/model/provider kind and BOTH contract hashes in the plan hash; only the generation-params canonical string itself excludes the keys listed in generation_params_canonical_excludes
